description: Use for the recommended durable asynchronous workflow. Creates a private queued search job and returns a job id plus jobToken for progress polling, cursor paging, refinement, retry, cancellation, and CSV or JSON export.

brief.description: Natural-language business, geography, required signals, and exclusions. Use this instead of separate target and geography.

fields.description: Business fields to retain. Website and source evidence remain available for verification.

geography.description: City, region, country, or Worldwide. Required with target when brief is omitted.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for safely retrying the same job creation request.

limit.description: Maximum accepted prospects retained by the job.

target.description: Business type or concise ideal-customer target. Pair with geography when brief is omitted.

name: start_lead_search

cancelUrl.description: Authenticated REST URL for canceling queued or running work.

expiresInSeconds.description: Seconds until the private job and token expire.

exportUrl.description: Authenticated CSV export URL. Add format=json for JSON.

id.description: Stable job identifier. Use it with jobToken in every lifecycle call.

jobToken.description: Private bearer token required to read, refine, or export this job.

retryUrl.description: Authenticated REST URL for creating a replacement after retryable failure.

statusUrl.description: Authenticated REST URL for job status and result pages.

title: Start a durable lead search
